english.title: Operate equipment to observe another while breast-feeding a child
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated equipment with the intention of enabling yourself or a third person to observe another person while that person was breastfeeding a child and doing so without her consent and without reasonably believing that she did consent and with the intention that you or a third person would look at the image for the purpose of obtaining sexual gratification for yourself or that other person, or to humiliate, alarm or distress her
english.legislation: Contrary to section 67A(2A) and (4) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.

english.notes:
(i) A reference to breast-feeding a child includes re-arranging clothing, see section 67A(3A).
(ii) It is irrelevant whether the person breast-feeding is in a public place or not, and whether or not the person's breasts are exposed while breast-feeding and what part of the person's body is or is intended to be visible in the recorded image, see section 67A(3A).
(iii) As per section 67A(3)(a) if the offence is being committed for sexual gratification, the gratification can be for the person recording the offence or, for other persons.
(iv) See further paragraphs 29 to 34 of Home Office Circular 005/2022.
(v) Victims of this offence are entitled to anonymity under section 2 of the Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 1992.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 67A(4)(a) and (5) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
